post.description: Requires a current BANK_MANAGER principal with the existing bank.diagnostics.read permission and a valid CSRF token. This read-only report validates only the explicitly pinned canonical graphs; it does not establish accepted inventory, rights, qualified human review, assembly feasibility, or publication eligibility. The strict JSON body is limited to 1 MiB and requires no idempotency key.
